claim: In On-demand Standard mode, you are charged for each stream in your account at an hourly rate, in addition to the volume of data ingested and retrieved. On-demand Advantage removes this fixed, per-stream charge.

qualifiers.scope: per stream per hour, On-demand Standard mode
qualifiers.condition: On-demand Advantage removes the fixed, per-stream charge

evidence.quote: Per-Stream: You’re charged for each stream operating in the On-demand Standard mode in your account at an hourly rate.
In on-demand mode, pricing is based on the volume of data ingested and retrieved along with a per-hour charge for each data stream in your account.
On-demand Advantage also provides a simpler pricing structure that removes the fixed, per-stream charge, so customers only pay for data usage at better rates.
